days.title: Visitor Services and Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Besucherzentrum
stops.detail: A three-kilometer nature trail that presents nature, history and culture is located near the visitor center.

stops.name: Karhunkainalon
stops.detail: The center also operates the Karhunkainalon campsite, where equipment for fishing and hunting, snowmobiles, boats, bicycles, and camping gear are sold and rented.

stops.name: UKK-Wanderweg
stops.detail: The national UKK hiking trail, named after President Urho Kaleva Kekkonen, leads through the park to Kylmäluoma.

days.title: Ancient Canyons and Northern Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Julma-Ölkky
stops.detail: Julma-Ölkky, with Finland's largest canyon lake and its steep walls, is an impressive, two-billion-year-old natural monument.

stops.name: Somerjärvi
stops.detail: A 30 km connecting route leads from the northwestern corner of the hiking area at Lake Somerjärvi to the Kylmäluoma hiking area.

stops.name: Moilasenvaara
stops.detail: Moilasenvaara, on the other hand, is characterized by primeval forest, which has a special conservation value.

stops.name: Värikallio
stops.detail: The rock painting of Värikallio is located in Kainuu.

stops.name: Lounatkoskesta
stops.detail: There are reindeer herds in the area, and Lisää Lounatkoskesta is an old, operational water mill.
